battle.name: 郭子儀擊叛軍之戰
battle.brief: 天寶十四載末，安祿山在范陽起兵，河朔望風瓦解；郭子儀以朔方節度使奉詔討賊，與李光弼分道進軍河北，會師常山擊敗史思明，平河曲、收河東、攻潼關，至德二載會同回紇兵於香積寺收復長安。卡面亞述長弓未入中土，然角木筋複合、弓兵隨車射擊，正是唐軍角弓與回紇騎射的同源遠祖。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 這場戰爭是天寶末年唐廷平定安史之亂的河北戰線，交戰的兩方是唐與自號大燕的叛軍。唐方以兩京與關中為根本，倚靠開元以來成熟的節度使體制調兵：郭子儀出鎮朔方節度使，治靈州，李光弼領河東兵，顏真卿任平原太守在城郊募義兵，顏杲卿起兵常山，哥舒翰統潼關與關中精兵；玄宗、肅宗兩朝以詔令、度支與驛馬調度各道兵馬，河北、河南、關中三線並進。叛方以范陽、平盧、河東三鎮為巢穴，安祿山自領蕃漢兵，契丹、奚、室韋、靺鞨、突厥騎隊為其前驅，騎射是這支部隊的看家本事；安慶緒、史思明先後接掌兵權，河北州縣多為其勢力所及。這場亂事其實是唐廷未能及時壓制的一次藩鎮兵變，叛軍所據之地在河北，人事在河北，人心卻不全在河北，所以兩年之間局勢數度翻轉。回紇兵在至德二載一度與唐軍聯手，屬於朝廷倚為外援的一支。
countriesEn: This war was the Hebei front in the Tang court's attempt to put down the An Lushan rebellion in the last years of the Tianbao era, and the two belligerents were the Tang on one side and the rebels, who called themselves the Yan state, on the other. The Tang rested on the two capitals and on Guanzhong, and moved troops through the mature system of military governors built up since the Kaiyuan era: Guo Ziyi took the governorship of Shuofang with its seat at Lingzhou, Li Guangbi led the forces of Hedong, Yan Zhenqing as governor of Pingyuan raised volunteer militia in the fields around the city, Yan Gaoqing rose in arms at Changshan, and Geshu Han commanded the garrison of Tong Pass and the picked troops of Guanzhong. Under Xuanzong and Suzong, edicts, the revenue administration and the imperial relay horses shifted troops out of every circuit, so that the Hebei, Henan and Guanzhong lines all advanced at once. The rebel side used the three circuits of Fanyang, Pinglu and Hedong as its lair. An Lushan commanded the mixed foreign and Chinese army himself, with the cavalry bands of the Khitan, Xi, Shiwei, Mohe and Turks as his vanguard, and mounted archery was the specialty of this force. An Qingxu and Shi Siming took over the command in turn, and most prefectures of Hebei lay within their reach. The disturbance was in truth a warlord revolt that the court had failed to suppress in time: the rebels held Hebei and staffed it with their own men, yet did not hold all the hearts of Hebei, which is why the situation turned over several times within two years. Uighur troops fought alongside the Tang once in the second year of Zhide, and formed the external support on which the court relied.
people: 郭子儀是這場戰爭的另一面旗幟。他是華州鄭縣人，武舉出身，歷仕玄宗、肅宗、代宗、德宗四朝，天寶末以朔方節度使出師，是最早響應平叛的方面之一。顏真卿在平原散財募兵、遣使夜行說郭子儀反戈，是河北能續戰的關鍵一著；其兄顏杲卿在常山起兵，父子同城，河北才有了可以依託的支點。李光弼以河東精兵與郭子儀分道進河北，兩軍會師常山，擊敗史思明，是全役第一個硬碰硬的勝利。哥舒翰守潼關、崔乾祐據險設伏，把官軍號稱二十萬眾葬在關外，迫使玄宗西幸蜀中。叛軍一方，安祿山在范陽發兵，安慶緒、史思明相繼接掌兵權，安守忠、李歸仁、張通儒、嚴莊各領一軍；魚朝恩以監軍身分節制九節度使，759年鄴城一役，唐軍號稱六十萬眾潰散，郭子儀反被罷去兵權，閒居京師。戰後僕固懷恩勾結回紇、吐蕃進犯關中，郭子儀再以數十騎入回紇營，說其反攻吐蕃，唐室才沒有在第二場內亂中崩掉。
peopleEn: Guo Ziyi was the banner on the other side of this war. Born in Zheng county in Huazhou, he had come up through the martial examination and served four emperors in turn - Xuanzong, Suzong, Daizong and Dezong. At the end of the Tianbao era he went to the front as military governor of Shuofang, and was one of the first to answer the call against the rebels. Yan Zhenqing scattered his wealth in Pingyuan to raise volunteers and sent an envoy by night to persuade Guo Ziyi to turn his troops; that was the key move by which resistance in Hebei was able to continue. Yan's elder brother Yan Gaoqing rose in arms at Changshan, so that father and son in one city gave the loyalist side a point of support. Li Guangbi marched into Hebei with picked troops from Hedong by a separate road from Guo Ziyi; when the two forces met at Changshan they beat Shi Siming, and that was the first genuinely hard-won victory of the whole campaign. Geshu Han held Tong Pass while Cui Qianyou used the ground to lay his ambush, and buried the imperial host, claimed at twenty myriad, outside the pass, forcing Xuanzong to flee west into Shu. On the rebel side An Lushan raised his army at Fanyang and An Qingxu and Shi Siming succeeded him in turn, with An Shouzhong, Li Guiren, Zhang Tongru and Yan Zhuang each commanding a corps. Yuzhao'en, as supervisor of the imperial forces, controlled the nine military governors, and at Ye City in 759 the Tang host, claimed at sixty myriad, broke up; Guo Ziyi was stripped of his command and sat out his term in the capital. After the war Puyu Huai'en drew the Uighurs and the Tibetans into an attack on Guanzhong, and Guo Ziyi once more rode with only a few dozen men into the Uighur camp and persuaded them to turn on the Tibetans instead, so that the Tang house did not collapse in a second civil war.
kits: 卡面上的亞述長弓，是兩河流域亞述人用於車陣的複合角弓：木為芯、角在外、筋在背，張力強而形制短，弓兵自車上發矢，車前以持盾步兵遮蔽，車兵則靠弓兵清出射界。這種角木筋三層複合、貼身反張的弓，與唐代軍府所造的角弓、桑木長弓同屬一族；唐代弓兵是步軍的骨幹，長弓施於遠射，角弓供騎兵與近陣，弩則以擘張弩、伏遠弩、角端弩補其不足。河西走廊自漢以來就是複合角弓東傳的孔道，唐軍所用的胡弓、波斯弓，與契丹、奚、室韋、回紇騎兵手上的獵弓，同出一源。叛軍的蕃騎尤其倚仗這種馬上角弓，開弓即發、發即離弦，對付唐軍步陣最為棘手。郭子儀的朔方軍本以騎兵見長，卻仍以步軍弓兵配槊、鎧、拒馬成陣；安守忠、李歸仁部在香積寺北面列陣，也是以步騎雜陳、弓弩在前遮蔽車營的方式應戰。可見亞述長弓的形制雖未隨使節抵達長安，它所代表的射擊技術與車步配合，卻在這場戰爭的兩軍陣中同時存在。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card is the composite horn bow used by the Assyrians of Mesopotamia in their chariot formations: wood for the core, horn on the outside, sinew across the back, powerful in tension though short in the hand, with the archers loosing from the platform of the chariot while shield-bearing infantry screened the front and the chariotry advanced behind the archers. That three-layer composite of horn, wood and sinew, bent close to the archer, belongs to the same family as the horn bows and long mulberry bows built in the Tang arsenals. In Tang practice the archer was the backbone of the infantry: long bows for distance, horn bows for the cavalry and for close fighting, with the crossbow - in its powerful wall-crossing, long-range draw and horned-nose forms - making up the rest. The Hexi Corridor had been the conduit for composite horn bows travelling east since the Han dynasty, and the Hu and Persian bows used by the Tang, together with the hunting bows of the Khitan, Xi, Shiwei and Uighur horsemen, all came out of the same source. The rebel foreign cavalry relied on this horse-borne horn bow above all, loosing and riding off at once, and it was the most awkward of enemies for a Tang infantry block. Guo Ziyi's Shuofang army was famous for its cavalry, yet it still formed up with infantry archers, spears, armour and caltrops; and the corps of An Shouzhong and Li Guiren drew up north of Xiangji Temple in the same fashion, infantry and cavalry mixed, bows and crossbows screening the wagon forts in front. The Assyrian form itself never reached Chang'an with an embassy, yet the technique of shooting that it stands for, and the combination of chariot and step that it embodies, were present in the battle lines of both armies in this war.
tactics: 起手是分道：郭子儀與李光弼各率一軍，自河東北上，免得被史思明各個擊破，會師常山後再合兵掃清河北州縣；其後郭子儀回軍河東，與回紇兵平定河曲，趁勢收復河東、同州，一路由北向南壓向潼關。潼關這一仗是全役最典型的以險制勝：崔乾祐挑出精兵預伏於關內南原之下，佯作敗走誘官軍深入隘道，再以數百精兵斷其糧道，於隘道積草放火，煙焰蔽天，官軍不辨南北、自相踐踏，潼關遂陷。肅宗即位後，戰略改為先固鳳翔行在、通西域援軍，再圖兩京：至德二載九月，郭子儀、李光弼與廣平王李俶率唐與回紇兵十五萬，列陣於香積寺北，營柵依灃水而築，退者斬；先以三百騎挑戰撼其營，繼而回紇騎兵繞出敵陣之後，與唐軍前後夾擊，安守忠、李歸仁部大潰，斬首六萬，張通儒奔保陝州，西京遂復。乘勝東進，於新店大破嚴莊、張通儒十五萬眾，安慶緒退出東都。兵法講到底是一句話：分進合擊，斷其糧道，然後以騎兵繞背，收其全功。
tacticsEn: The opening was a split advance. Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi each led a separate column northward out of Hedong, so that Shi Siming could not destroy them one at a time, and only after meeting at Changshan did they close up and sweep the Hebei prefectures. Guo Ziyi then turned back into Hedong, joined the Uighurs in pacifying the River Bend, seized Hedong and Tongzhou, and pressed south toward Tong Pass in one continuous line. The fighting at Tong Pass was the classic case of a strong position beating an advancing enemy: Cui Qianyou picked out picked troops and posted them in ambush south of the pass, pretended to run so as to draw the imperial army deep into the defile, cut its supply line with several hundred men, and set fire to the stacked brush in the narrow way. The smoke and flame blotted out the sky, the imperial troops could no longer tell north from south and trod on one another, Tong Pass fell, and the emperor fled west. After Suzong took the throne the strategy changed to first secure the travelling court at Fengxiang, keep the flow of reinforcements from the western regions open, and only then take the two capitals. In the ninth month of the second year of Zhide, Guo Ziyi, Li Guangbi and Prince Guangping Li Chu led fifteen myriad Tang and Uighur troops and deployed north of Xiangji Temple, the camp built along the Feng River and every man who retreated to be executed. Three hundred cavalry went forward to shake the rebel camp; then the Uighur horsemen wheeled past to the enemy's rear and struck front and back together, the corps of An Shouzhong and Li Guiren collapsed, sixty thousand were counted among the dead, Zhang Tongru fled to Shanzhou, and the western capital was recovered. Pressing on east, they broke Yan Zhuang and Zhang Tongru's host of fifteen myriad at Xindian, and An Qingxu gave up the eastern capital. The art of war comes down to one sentence: advance by separate columns, join forces, cut the enemy's supply line, then send the cavalry round his back and take the credit of the whole.
data: 這場戰爭可核的數字大致如此：安祿山在范陽起兵，號蕃漢兵十五萬，自范陽南下，一月而陷洛陽；潼關前官軍號稱二十萬，崔乾祐以數百精兵斷糧道、伏火攻之，官軍死傷過萬人，關隘失守，玄宗西幸；至德二載九月收復長安的香積寺之役，唐與回紇合兵十五萬，一戰斬首六萬；收復洛陽之後，安慶緒北走范陽，史思明於范陽再舉兵，鄴城之役叛軍援軍約十三萬、官軍號稱六十萬而潰；廣德元年史朝義在幽州自盡，安史之亂自755年起凡八年。距離方面，洛陽至長安官道行軍約數百里，河北自范陽至常山、再到河東靈州更是遼遠，朔方軍由靈州出師，東出河東、經井陘入河北，行程以千餘里計。兵員結構上，朔方與河東兩鎮以邊軍精騎為骨，顏真卿在平原所募義兵則多為州縣丁壯，靠城守與步射作戰；郭子儀督軍之日，也多次以屯田與鹽利充軍食，大曆初年屯於河中，即以此自足。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked for this war run roughly as follows. An Lushan rose at Fanyang with a mixed army numbered at fifteen myriad, marched south out of Fanyang and had Luoyang within a month. Before Tong Pass the imperial host was claimed at twenty myriad, but Cui Qianyou cut the supply line with several hundred picked men and attacked with fire; the imperial dead and wounded exceeded ten thousand, the pass was lost, and Xuanzong fled west. In the battle for the recovery of Chang'an at Xiangji Temple in the ninth month of the second year of Zhide, the Tang and Uighur together numbered fifteen myriad and sixty thousand of the enemy were counted among the dead in a single engagement. After Luoyang was retaken, An Qingxu ran north to Fanyang, Shi Siming rose in arms at Fanyang again, and at the battle of Ye City the rebel relief force numbered about thirteen myriad while the Tang host, claimed at sixty myriad, broke up. In the first year of Guangde Shi Chaoyi killed himself at Youzhou, and the rebellion, which had begun in 755, had run eight years. As for distances, the official road from Luoyang to Chang'an is several hundred li, and from Fanyang to Changshan and on to the Shuofang seat at Lingzhou is far longer; the Shuofang army marched out of Lingzhou, eastward through Hedong and in by the Jingxing route into Hebei, a journey counted in more than a thousand li. In composition, the picked cavalry of the two northern circuits formed the core of the Tang army, while the volunteers Yan Zhenqing raised at Pingyuan were for the most part county militia, fighting from fixed positions with bow and foot. Guo Ziyi, at the head of his army, fed the troops time and again from reclaimed fields and salt revenue, and the garrison he held at Hezhong in the early Dali years made the army self-supporting.
cause: 起兵的根由在安祿山身上。此人原是營州出身的胡人將領，靠驍勇與諂媚得玄宗寵信，先後兼領范陽、平盧、河東三鎮節度使，掌河朔精兵十餘萬，朝廷倚為屏蔽契丹與吐蕃的長城。玄宗晚年寵楊國忠，國忠屢以文抑武、譏刺祿山，祿山自料久後見誅；天寶十四載秋，朝廷有召他入朝之議，祿山遂以奉密詔討楊國忠為名舉兵，遣使脅持郡縣，河北州縣望風瓦解。這背後更有制度性的病根：開元以來府兵制崩解，兵歸節度使，朝廷養不起常備軍，只得以募兵、客軍與蕃兵湊數，節度使既握兵又握財、握地，等到安史二人聯手，河北的軍力實際上已經不受朝廷節制。一場平叛戰爭之所以一打就是八年，第一步卻只是河北兩名反叛節度使對中央的一次武裝試探。
causeEn: The reasons for the rising lie with An Lushan himself. A Hu general by birth from the old military settlement at Yingzhou, he had won the favour of Emperor Xuanzong by bravery and flattery, and in succession held the military governorship of the three circuits of Fanyang, Pinglu and Hedong, with more than a hundred thousand of the finest Hebei troops under him, so that the court leaned on him as a wall against the Khitan and the Tibetans. In the last years of Xuanzong's reign Yang Guozhong held the chancellorship and repeatedly used the weapon of the scholar to put down the frontier general and to twit him; An Lushan reckoned that in due course he would be put to death. In the autumn of the fourteenth year of Tianbao a discussion arose at court of summoning him to the capital, and he raised his banner on the pretext of a secret imperial edict to punish Yang Guozhong, sending envoys to coerce the prefectures, and the prefectures of Hebei fell away without a fight. Behind this lay a structural failing: since Kaiyuan the fubing militia system had collapsed, troops belonged to the military governors, the court could no longer afford a standing army and had to fill the ranks with recruits, hired auxiliaries and foreign soldiers, and the governors held troops and revenue and territory at once. By the time the two men of An and Shi joined hands, the military force of Hebei had in truth already slipped out of the court's control. The war that was to run eight years thus began with a single armed probe by two rebel governors of Hebei against the centre.
impact: 打完之後，唐朝的格局就換了樣子。兩京復歸，玄宗、肅宗父子相繼回駕，禮儀軍容重新排開，天子的威儀勉強接續；骨子裡卻是節度使的兵權再沒有交回去過。魏博、成德、盧龍與河東相繼割據，河北自成一體，唐廷的兩京成了孤島，靠關中、蜀中與江淮的財賦供養；成德、魏博驕橫，世稱河朔三鎮，此後百餘年，藩鎮終於把唐推向崩解。戰亂還牽動了外圍：吐蕃趁中原大亂盡取河隴，河西走廊斷絕，長安與西域的交通一度中斷；回紇以助軍為名兩度入寇，直到廣德二年涇陽之役郭子儀單騎說其轉攻吐蕃，唐室才換來又一次喘息。戶口與生產的損耗同樣沉重：天寶盛時全國戶近九百萬，亂後官方簿籍只存二百九十萬餘，其中固然夾雜避籍逃戶，仍看得出北方田園的荒蕪與戶籍的崩壞。戰後唐軍的兵制也徹底改頭換面，府兵之名猶在，實則募兵、客軍當家，騎兵與蕃將成為骨幹，弓兵退居步軍之列——亞述長弓那樣的角弓技術並未失傳，只是改了名字，叫作角弓。
impactEn: When the fighting was over, the shape of the Tang had changed. The two capitals were recovered, father and son - Xuanzong and Suzong - returned to the capital in turn, the ceremonial array and the military pomp were set up again, and the emperor's authority was reconnected in outward form; in substance, however, the military governors never gave their troops back. Weibo, Chengde, Lulong and Hedong in turn became autonomous, Hebei stood apart as a separate world, and the two capitals of the Tang became islands fed by the revenue of Guanzhong, of Shu and of the Yangzi. Chengde and Weibo grew insolent, and the circuit troops of Heshuo became a power that would, over more than a century, push the Tang towards collapse. The upheaval also pulled at the fringes: the Tibetans took the whole of Hexi and Longyou while the Central Plain was in chaos, the corridor was cut, and traffic between Chang'an and the western regions was interrupted for a time. The Uighurs invaded twice on the pretext of helping the war, and only at Jingyang in the second year of Guangde, when Guo Ziyi rode out alone among them and turned them against the Tibetans, did the Tang house win another respite. The toll in households and in production was heavy as well: in the prosperous years of Tianbao the empire had close to nine million households on the register, and after the war the official tally kept only some two million nine hundred thousand - though fugitives from the register make up part of that figure, it still shows how the fields of the north lay waste and how the household registers were shattered. The military system of the Tang was wholly recast as well. The name of the fubing survived, but recruits and hired auxiliaries were the army in fact, cavalry and foreign generals were its backbone, and the archer slipped back to a place among the foot. A technique like the Assyrian bow did not die out; it merely changed its name, to horn bow.
result: 結果分兩層看。戰役這一層：唐軍在常山擊敗史思明，收復河東、同州與河北諸州，於至德二載九月會同回紇兵收復長安，十二月進取洛陽，安慶緒退出河北；官軍的戰果是把叛軍從兩京趕回范陽，收復西京與東都，終結了第一階段的失守。戰局這一層：河北並未因此平定，史思明在范陽再舉兵，攻陷洛陽與魏州，鄴城一役唐軍號稱六十萬眾潰散；郭子儀在這場敗局裡被罷去兵權，閒居京師。一直等到廣德元年，史朝義在幽州窮蹙自盡，河北才盡歸朝廷，八年的亂事才算了結。而安史之亂真正的尾聲並不在戰場：郭子儀以一身繫關安，受封汾陽郡王，尚昇平公主，四朝不見譴，士大夫稱其富貴壽考；而那批在亂中握兵的將帥，成了晚唐藩鎮的胚芽。
resultEn: The outcome has two layers. On the field of battle, the Tang army beat Shi Siming at Changshan, recovered Hedong, Tongzhou and the prefectures of Hebei, took Chang'an in the ninth month of the second year of Zhide together with the Uighurs, moved on to Luoyang in the twelfth month, and drove An Qingxu out of Hebei; the tangible result was that the rebels were pushed back from the two capitals into Fanyang, and the western and eastern capitals were retaken, which ended the first phase of the collapse. In the war as a whole, Hebei was not pacified by that. Shi Siming rose again at Fanyang, took Luoyang and Weizhou, and at Ye City the Tang host, claimed at sixty myriad, broke up; Guo Ziyi was stripped of his command in that defeat and sat out his term in the capital. It was not until the first year of Guangde, when Shi Chaoyi killed himself at Youzhou in extremity, that Hebei came back to the court and the eight years of disorder were closed out. The true epilogue of the An Lushan rebellion lay not on the battlefield: Guo Ziyi, on whom the safety of the realm rested, was made Prince of Fenyang, married the Princess Shengping, and was never once reprimanded across four reigns - the literati called him the very image of wealth, rank and longevity - while that band of commanders who had held troops during the disorder became the embryo of the late Tang's regional warlords.
